chief_complaint: Shortness of breath, especially on exertion, and swelling in my ankles.
doctor_notes: Patient presents with increased SOB and bilateral ankle edema, consistent with CHF exacerbation. BP elevated. Recent non-adherence to diuretic regimen noted. Current diabetes management suboptimal. Plan to adjust diuretic dosage and review medication adherence. Emphasize low-sodium diet and daily weights.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Hello Eleanor, thanks for coming in. Tell me what's been bothering you.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Doctor, I've been getting so breathless lately, even just walking to the mailbox. And my ankles are so swollen, my shoes don't even fit.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. When did this start to get worse?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Probably the last week or so. I haven't been taking my water pill as regularly.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Okay, we'll need to get that back on track. Your blood pressure is also a bit high today.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: I know, I haven't been feeling as well. And my sugar levels have been a bit up too, I think.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: We'll review your labs and make some adjustments to your medications to help with the fluid and your blood pressure. It's crucial you stick to your prescribed regimen, Eleanor.

follow_up_actions: Increase Furosemide dose to 40 mg twice daily.
Monitor daily weights and blood pressure.
Reinforce adherence to medication and low-sodium diet.
